context:
Goal: the work goes on now, and you can overrule any coordinator pick.
Problem (goal): the coordinator took this undoable pick on Nov 12, 11:38 CST without asking you; it stands unless you choose b.
Based on (notes): coordinator message, 12:12 to 12:16 CST Nov 12.
Departs from: main has no such pick on record — the work it governs follows this pick.

options.gain: Steps with those statuses stop being shown as unknown.
options.how: The roadmap build learns three more step statuses: blocked, queued and folded. Blocked and folded steps are counted but not listed in the two status rows; queued is listed like todo.
options.label: Keep the pick (Recommended)
options.lose: The other route is not taken unless you choose b.

options.gain: The other route, if you prefer it.
options.how: Keep the build's current list of statuses.
options.label: Overrule it
options.lose: The governed work is redone or waits for the change.

reply: Kept in part 13:19 CST Nov 12 after the retrospective's audit (blocked step with an empty or finished blocker list is listed, not only counted). Your 12:11 CST Nov 13 note 'ensure this is above board how we operate our glossary': checked. GLOSSARY.md on main has no row for step statuses; the three new ones (blocked, queued, folded) have no glossary entry, and 'queued' is listed like todo, which is two names for one thing (the glossary gives each thing one name). A follow-up adds rows for blocked and folded and drops 'queued' as an alias of todo; step glossary-step-statuses (todo) holds it.
short: Roadmap build: three more step statuses it knows
